shipLog.text: ◆ Seeds planted! CHIP has enrolled your crop in GrowCo™ Rewards! You are now earning points! Points cannot be redeemed in space!
NOW ARRIVING: Soil Sample Paradise! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at The Paperwork: “Sign everything without reading”! BOLD leadership!
◆ Planetary body detected! CHIP checked: it is not sponsored! An entire planet, generic! Chilling!
NOW ARRIVING: The Bargain Bin! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Sleet: “Bow into it and take the sleet”! BOLD leadership!
You turn the armored bow into the stream and let it hiss… RESULTS: −5 HULL, −3 H2O, 1 DAY. ★★☆☆☆ Rate us anyway!
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Market Row: “BACK TO DOCK”! BOLD leadership!

identity.name: Meridian Slate
identity.story: They are a corporate auditor. They boarded secretly to audit the mission in situ, which is even less legal than stowing away, a point they concede while showing you a briefcase full of forms about your fuel consumption. The company does not know they are here. The company, they add quietly, does not know a lot of things.
identity.line: Before you decide anything: your ration accounting is impeccable. I checked. I couldn't help it.
identity.join_note: No shipboard skills whatsoever. Fills out arrival paperwork so well the colony office may weep.
